text_block_list.text:
—The Fan Appreciation Festival.
At Tracen Academy, on that day and that day only...
(Ding-a-ling)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Welcome.
A cozy coffee shop that normally doesn't existis supposedly opening for a limited time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Thank you for waiting.
Here is a specially roasted Manhattan Blend.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Please, have a drink...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: Don't you need to attend to the other customers?
Don't you have to help the other customers?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: There's no one around, after all. The tranquility is part of the charm, and besides...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure no one will find it. Even if you
go in through the entrance, you end up at the exit..."

...It seems space is twisting quite considerably.
Though I'm not sure what it opened for...
(Ding-a-ling)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sniff, sniff... What a lovely aroma!
I knew there'd be a cafe tucked away here!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah, so this is Cafe's shop!

The one who walked in was Special Week,
the cheerful Umamusume born in Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, could I please get the
"Wicked Mega-Cream Coffee"!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes. Spe-san,
how did you know about this place...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: How did you find it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, that's because...
it smelled so good?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Looks delicious... I see...

"Even though she agreed verbally,
Manhattan Cafe kept looking at Special Week
with a suspicious glare..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting.
I'll set down the "Einspänner (Large)" right here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that really is a lot of whipped cream! All right,
I'll drink this and give it my all for today's Fan Fest
and the spring races!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... Spe-san?
Which spring races... are you entering...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh, my race schedule?
I'm thinking about various races, but
the one I've definitely decided to run is...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho... (Spring)... Just as I thought...

A race Manhattan Cafe is also scheduled to run in.
Does Special Week coming to this shop have something to do with that?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This is... guidance...
It must be because we are rivals... that we met in this shop...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san......
I'll... run too......

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm running too... in the Tenno Sho (Spring)...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, you too, Cafe-san?
T-This is a formidable opponent.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh, if it's come to this, today I'll power up with that strategy! Using my specialty!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Signature move...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Cafe-san! Give me all the sweets on the menu, please! The milk macarons, the apple custard, all of it!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Give me everything you've got in stock, please!

Stamina enhancement... Is that what this was?
Special Week finished off every single sweet she ordered.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we have a crisis...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No, more importantly...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Reckless, gluttonous overeating. To think
such a training method even existed...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose...
I can't...
A cozy coffee shopthat normally doesn't exist—

The owner of that shop was an Umamusume
whose worries were always slightly misdirected.
(Ding-a-ling)

Just then, the doorbell that shouldn't have rung chimed,
and a noisy crowd of people came flooding in.

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Oho, this is it, this is it!
The coffee shop run by that Manhattan Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, what a lovely atmosphere~! The interior is wonderful too, as expected~!
I'm such a huge fan~."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Eh, um...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But, what is this...?
How on earth did you find it?
choice_data_list: That just shows how desperately they searched for you.

text_block_list.text:
Thanks in part to her recent success,
Manhattan Cafe's popularity is skyrocketing rapidly.
It seemed that fame had drawn in the fans. And then—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What's with this crowd~!? Cafe-chan won't
be able to run the shop all on her own like this.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll help out too!
Master, one lemon squash, one milkshake,
and a homemade Napolitan, please~!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa... I'm not a waiter or a butler,
y'know. Quit swarming around me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tch, don't come crying to me if you get burned.
Though if you're prepared for that—I'll play with you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the shop's...
concept is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Still... trendy shops are nice once in a while.
It's better than nobody showing up every year...

Countless fans and Umamusume gathered
around Manhattan Cafe—
and the shop became a roaring success.
